settings.heading: Plan the whole job, room by room, on your store.
settings.text: Give homeowners and trade pros a place to plan the whole job on your store. They organize tile, paint, fixtures, and furniture by room, set quantities, and share lists with clients. You turn finished plans into carts, quotes, and draft orders.
settings.caption: The new full-page Projects experience. It lives at its own URL on your storefront with zero setup, with room-by-room filtering, sharing with or without prices, and PDF downloads. Prefer the classic widget? It lives on the account page as a theme app block.

settings.title: Multiple wishlists & projects
settings.text: Customers create as many wishlists as they need, one per project, room, client, or season, and manage them all from their account page.

settings.title: Product groups & subgroups
settings.text: The only Shopify wishlist app with true grouping. Organize saved products into groups within a list by room, phase, or category, and filter instantly.

settings.title: Quantities built in
settings.text: Buyers set the exact quantity of every variant right on the wishlist. Perfect for wholesale orders, bulk buying, and project takeoffs.

settings.title: One-click add all to cart
settings.text: Move an entire wishlist to the cart in one click. Out-of-stock and low-inventory items are handled gracefully so the rest of the order still goes through.

settings.title: Shareable wishlist links
settings.text: Customers share wishlists with clients, teams, and family via a public link. Merchants can optionally hide pricing on shared lists.

settings.title: PDF quote export
settings.text: Export any wishlist as a clean PDF with line items, quantities, and pricing, ready to send as a quote or project proposal.

settings.title: Wishlist to draft order
settings.text: Convert any customer wishlist into a Shopify draft order in seconds. Apply wholesale pricing or bulk discounts and send the invoice. It's a full B2B quote workflow.

settings.title: Merchant dashboard
settings.text: See every customer wishlist from the Shopify admin. Know what buyers are planning before they order, and follow up with the right offer.

settings.title: Custom terminology
settings.text: Rename "Wishlist" to anything you like: Projects, Boards, Quotes, Favorites. The new term applies across every widget to match how your customers actually talk.

settings.title: Matches your theme
settings.text: Theme app blocks with customizable colors, text, and styles for every widget. No code required, and it looks native to your storefront.

settings.title: Wishlist buttons everywhere
settings.text: Add-to-wishlist buttons on product pages and wishlist icons on collection pages, so customers can save products wherever they browse.

settings.title: SKUs & metafields
settings.text: Surface SKUs and product or variant metafields directly on the wishlist. It's the detail B2B buyers and spec-driven shoppers expect.

settings.question: What makes this different from other Shopify wishlist apps?
settings.answer: Most wishlist apps are simple save-for-later lists. B2B Wishlist Project Planner adds the tools serious buyers need: multiple wishlists, product groups and subgroups within each list, per-item quantities, PDF quote exports, and wishlist-to-draft-order conversion for B2B sales. It's a wishlist and a project planner in one app.

settings.question: Does it work for B2B and wholesale stores?
settings.answer: Yes. B2B is what it's built for. Buyers set quantities on every item, organize large orders into groups, and export PDF quotes. Merchants convert any wishlist into a Shopify draft order, apply wholesale or bulk pricing, and send an invoice.

settings.question: Can customers share their wishlists?
settings.answer: Yes. Customers generate a public share link for any wishlist, which is great for sharing project plans with clients or gift lists with family. Merchants can choose to hide pricing on shared wishlists.

settings.question: What are the two interfaces?
settings.answer: You can offer either customer experience, or both. The classic widget lives on the account page as a theme app block. The new full-page Projects experience is a dedicated, beautifully designed page served at its own URL on your storefront with zero setup: customers get a visual overview of every project, filter items by room or phase, share lists with or without prices (by link or email), and download PDF quotes.

settings.question: Will it match my store's theme?
settings.answer: Yes. The widgets are Shopify theme app blocks with customizable colors, styles, and text, so they inherit your store's look. You can even rename "Wishlist" to "Project", "Board", or any term that fits your brand.

settings.question: How much does it cost?
settings.answer: There's a free plan with unlimited wishlists, subgroups, quantities, and sharing. The Project planner plan is $29/month with a 14-day free trial and adds PDF quote export and draft order conversion. See current pricing on the Shopify App Store listing.

settings.question: Who builds and supports the app?
settings.answer: The app is built and supported by Conspire, a Shopify Premier Partner agency founded in Los Angeles. You get support from the same senior team that builds Shopify stores for leading brands. Have a question or feature request? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.
